name: Spider-Man
summary: Spider-Man: Toys “R” Us Exclusive Edition is a retail-exclusive version of the HyperScan Spider-Man game. It contains the standard game pack and an additional IntelliCard, card 059, “Quick Learner”. The card is an Enemy Mod that gives the player extra experience upon completing a level and makes enemies slightly tougher. The edition does not appear to include different game software; the difference is the extra card included with the Toys “R” Us release.
